decision_notes: National legislature/chamber identity cross-checked against the institution, Wikidata and the primary IPU profile where accessible. This is separate from media and rights evidence. Primary evidence: https://data.ipu.org/parliament/SI/SI-UC01/

The National Council is the national upper chamber, as separately identified by IPU, with legislative initiative and suspensive-veto functions. The 43rd plenary and a public education/culture committee recording play; it is not a municipal council. National Assembly and TV SLO3 coverage are separate, unvalidated leads.

Source conditions: The reviewed official viewing pages designate public access, but no independent audiovisual reuse grant was established. Institutional ownership and working platform playback are not permission to extract, embed or redistribute media.
Catalogue, flags, localized country/jurisdiction search, map and planned schedule-source links reconciled. Link-out only; no HLS or implemented EPG promotion.
